message.content:
**Classic Baked Lasagna – Ingredients** | Category | Typical Items | |----------|---------------| | **Noodles** | • 9–12 sheets of regular lasagna pasta
• *Or* 1 box of “no‑boil” lasagna sheets if you want to skip pre‑cooking them | | **Meat Sauce** | • ½ lb ground beef (or half beef + half pork)
• ¼ cup finely chopped onion
• 2 cloves minced garlic
• 24 oz tomato sauce (crushed or passata)
• 8 oz canned diced tomatoes (optional for extra body)
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• Pinch red‑pepper flakes (if desired)
• Salt & black pepper to taste | | **Cheese Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese (room temperature)
• ¾ cup grated Parmigiano‑Reggiano (plus more for topping)
• 1 egg (helps bind the ricotta mixture)
• 2 cups shredded mozzarella (partly low‑fat, partly whole milk depending on preference) | | **Herbs & Seasonings** | • Fresh parsley or basil leaves (for garnish)
• Extra salt & pepper as needed | | **Extras (optional)** | • Sautéed spinach, sliced mushrooms, diced bell peppers, or roasted eggplant slices added into layers for veggie variation.
• A splash of dry white wine mixed into the meat sauce adds depth.
• For a richer béchamel layer, replace some ricotta with a light roux‑based white sauce. | --- ### Quick Prep Checklist 1. **Cook Noodles:** Boil until al dente (~8 minutes), drain, rinse under cold water, lay flat so they don’t stick together. 2. **Make Meat Sauce:** Brown the meat, add onions & garlic, then stir in tomatoes, herbs, seasonings—let simmer ~20 min. 3. **Prepare Cheese Mixture:** Beat ricotta, egg, parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, salt, pepper. 4. **Assemble Layers:** - Start with a thin spread of sauce at bottom of baking dish. - Place first noodle sheet over sauce. - Spread ricotta mix, sprinkle mozzarella, drizzle sauce again. Repeat layering until all components used, finishing with a generous top layer of sauce and mozzarella. 5. **Bake:** Cover with foil (tent it slightly to avoid sticking). Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 min, remove foil, bake another 10–15 min till bubbly and golden. 6. **Rest & Serve:** Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Garnish with fresh basil or parsley. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
